scope: Four original transparent PNGs, independently rendered fixed bases and mobile pieces. Two true source forms per montage/support. Source PNG bytes are copied verbatim; alpha rectangles were measured without pixel editing.
simulation: No simulation or save changes in renderer. Only owner presentation phases, motion and finite remaining reserves are read. No draw-time clock, RNG, autonomous idle cycle, damage, cost or resource grant.

Row1 col1 fixed ankle trap EMPTY two-pivot wood base WITHOUT jaw; col2 separate hooked hinged left iron jaw; col3 separate matching right iron jaw; col4 fixed rectangular metal blade trap base with bare axle NO blades; col5 separate long sharpened rusty blade pointing RIGHT with circle hinge at LEFT; col6 separate shorter counterblade pointing RIGHT with circle hinge at LEFT. Row3 col1 fixed clamp EMPTY steel-braced timber frame with side hinges NO jaws; col2 separate large serrated clamp LEFT jaw hinge at left; col3 separate matching RIGHT jaw hinge at right; col4 fixed counterweight low timber and steel fulcrum base NO lever; col5 separate long rusted metal weighted swinging beam pointing right with hinge hole at left; col6 separate iron suspended square weight with short chain. Create ONE original realistic 2D game SPRITE ATLAS for DEADWALL with fully transparent background, NO terrain, NO backdrop, NO text, NO labels, NO extra props. LANDSCAPE canvas 1536 x 1024, STRICT THREE columns SIX rows: EIGHTEEN isolated detached parts in equal 512 x 170 cells with ample pure transparent margins. Strict directly overhead orthographic view, NO perspective/isometric. This is visual variant TWO of improvised spring zombie traps, using blackened steel with faded olive-grey paint, salvage riveted plates, pale repaired timber, visibly different construction from rusty timber version. Each ROW is one trap, THREE columns: left is ONLY fixed low base/frame with EMPTY hinges, middle is ONLY first detached mobile part, right is ONLY second detached mobile part. Row1 ankle restraint: riveted two-pivot base, left hooked spring jaw, matching opposite hooked jaw. Row2 blades: polygon riveted base empty axle, separate curved long machete-like industrial blade pointing right, separate straight short shear arm pointing right. Row3 guide rails: two flat weathered narrow tracks, separate hooked transverse sliding bar, separate square toothed sliding sled. Row4 ratchet: dark steel fixed open bracket, separate toothed ratchet lever pointing right, separate spring and locking hook. Row5 clamp: pale timber steel braced fixed chassis, separate thick dark steel left serrated jaw, matching opposite serrated jaw. Row6 counterweight: low riveted steel fixed fulcrum base, separate long timber iron weighted lever horizontal right, separate iron weight and short chain. NOTHING already assembled. Middle/right mobile components must remain individually isolated with true alpha gutters. Serious grounded survival game palette and readable top-down silhouettes suitable to animate on a 64-by-32-unit footprint. Detailed game sprite painting, no fantasy/neon.
